ns2:group.ns2:description:
Inside an 86-year-old steel yard in Reno, manager Richard Lane shows how a legacy business stays alive by adapting: fixing what breaks, improving what he can, and bringing his team along.
Richard runs the yard the way his predecessors did: hands-on, practical, and rooted in community. But the work has changed. Machines break. Orders pile up. The next generation needs training. In a place that once ran on paper and memory, Richard now uses ChatGPT as a second set of hands, helping him troubleshoot failing machines, build faster processes, and mentor his crew in real time. And now? It just might be the fastest metal shop in Reno.
Learn how ChatGPT is helping a small, decades-old business stay efficient in a job where something always needs fixing.

Rachael Sharp is preparing to take over the farm one day, and part of that process is learning the systems, calculations, and judgment her dad has built over 75 years. 今天要談談鵝口瘡和高碳水飲食。通常，念珠菌生活在體內，不會打擾您。除非吃抗生素，殺光控制念珠菌的細菌，造成菌種失衡，酵母菌過度生長，就有念珠菌。念珠菌在嘴裡，稱鵝口瘡，舌頭是白色。
吃大量糖也導致鵝口瘡。念珠菌喜歡糖和快速變糖的東西，如精製穀物和澱粉。這些東西可將中性念珠菌變不友好，稱念珠菌病。
念珠菌住6地方： 1.陰道 2.皮膚 3.喉嚨 4.嘴巴(鵝口瘡) 5.食道 6.胃腸道
增加鵝口瘡風險6因素： 1.吃類固醇 2.壓力 3.感染愛滋病毒 4.吃避孕藥或高雌激素 5.糖尿病 6.抗生素

是使用抗生素後，常見副作用是念珠菌太多，因體內細菌，原本可抑制酵母菌、真菌和黴菌。
腸道微生物群多數是細菌，少數是酵母菌、真菌和友善念珠菌，一切處於平衡。一旦抗生素消滅友善細菌，念珠菌就繁殖更多，具致病性。
念珠菌太多，會導致搔癢、灼熱感、疲勞、嘴角破和口臭(氨味)。
念珠菌會改變您的酸鹼值，使其偏鹼。 糖是念珠菌的主要燃料來源。
因免疫力降低，導致念珠菌太多的其他原因： 1.愛滋病毒或愛滋病 2.器官移植 3.類固醇藥 4.懷孕 5. 吃太多糖
通常，念珠菌太多會伴隨維生素D缺乏。 維生素D能抗真菌，也是全方位抗微生物劑。
有念珠菌要做3事： 1.吃D3k2，約2萬~3萬國際單位(IU) 2.不吃糖，改吃生酮飲食 3.吃益生菌食品，如酸菜(sauerkraut)、泡菜、發酵醃菜、無糖克菲爾(kefir)

ns2:group.ns2:title: 【正片】MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰×罗永浩！大山并非无法翻越 Founder of MiniMax - The Mountain Awaits to Be Crossed
ns2:group.ns2:description:
闫俊杰似乎很擅长通关。他出生在小县城，一路读到了清华博士后，又从商汤的实习生一路做到了副总裁。但这些还不够，他的敏锐、他的决心、他的抱负一直在提醒他应该走出来，参与到世界的变革中来，于是在 AI 革命到来的前一年，他成立了 AI 大模型公司 MiniMax，这个公司的名字好像也在描述着起点和终点。他希望中国的厂商可以成为引领世界的巨头，他希望 AI 能够改变每一个普通人的生活。他看起来安静沉着，可内心对竞争充满期待，期待着跟王者一决高下，期待着他亲手将少数精英的工具变为普惠大众的生产力。
《罗永浩的十字路口》第十三期，我们和 MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰聊一聊他的 AI 创业之路。
Yan Junjie seems remarkably good at clearing levels. Born in a small county town, he made his way to a Tsinghua postdoc and rose from intern to Vice President at SenseTime. But even that wasn’t enough. His sensitivity, resolve, and ambition kept reminding him that he needed to step out — to take part in reshaping the world. One year before the arrival of the AI revolution, he founded MiniMax, a frontier AI model company whose name feels like a metaphor for both origin and destination. He hopes Chinese companies can become global leaders. He hopes AI can transform the lives of everyday people. He appears quiet and composed, yet inside he carries a fierce anticipation for competition — the desire to challenge the giants and to personally turn elite tools into accessible productivity for all. In this thirteenth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we speak with MiniMax founder Yan Junjie about his AI journey, his entrepreneurial conviction, and the transformation he believes is coming.
